result.summary: The page is largely well-structured, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows clear defects: two identical duplicate restaurant cards and images that appear washed out by a white overlay (resembling a stuck loading/skeleton state), inconsistent with the fully rendered third card. A couple of minor contrast/decoration issues were also noted. Edge-clipped carousel items and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior.

issues.description: The first two cards in 'Fastest near you' are exact duplicates: same name ('Green Bowl Poké'), same image, same '15–25 min' badge and same '€0.90 delivery' text. This looks like duplicated/placeholder data rather than real distinct restaurants.
issues.suggestion: Deduplicate the carousel feed by restaurant ID and ensure each card renders unique restaurant data; add a fallback state if fewer than three distinct results are available.

issues.description: The two poké bowl images appear faded/low-contrast with a whitish gradient veil over them, while the third card (burger) is fully saturated. This inconsistency reads as a stuck shimmer/skeleton overlay or an incorrectly applied gradient mask on loaded images.
issues.suggestion: Remove the white overlay/gradient once images finish loading, or apply the same image treatment consistently across all carousel cards so loaded photos render at full opacity and contrast.

issues.description: The search field placeholder ('Restaurants, dishes, groceries') is light gray on a very light gray background, giving low contrast that may be hard to read for low-vision users.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (target at least 4.5:1 contrast against the field background) or use a darker field background.

issues.description: The decorative circles on the green promo banner create a visible hard seam/edge where the lighter circle shape meets the banner's bottom-right rounded corner, making the decoration look abruptly clipped.
issues.suggestion: Clip the decorative shapes to the banner's rounded container and soften their edges/opacity so the transition blends smoothly with the banner background.

issues.description: Cards in 'Fastest near you' show only name and delivery fee, while 'Popular right now' cards include rating, time, and cuisine. The missing rating/cuisine metadata makes the top carousel feel incomplete and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add rating and cuisine (or a placeholder such as 'New') to the compact cards so information density is consistent across sections.
